subject: Opening of Medford Community Media Center
overview: Mayor Stephanie Muccini Burke announced the opening of the new Medford Community Media Center at the Medford Vocational Technical High School. The facility provides a space for public access television while hosting media technology courses for students.

items.title: Medford Community Media Center Welcome
items.summary: Mayor Stephanie Muccini Burke introduced the new state-of-the-art studio, highlighting its dual purpose as an inclusive community space and an integrated educational facility for the vocational high school.
